# Apostra

> Apostra (formerly Scope3 and Interchange) helps you plan, run, and understand advertising across sellers from one connected place. Apostra connects authorised buyer and seller agents to advertising opportunities across media companies, formats and markets.

- [Developer documentation index](https://docs.apostra.com/llms.txt)
- [Build software with Apostra](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/overview)
- [Install and connect](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/quickstart)
- [Apostra for agents](https://apostra.com/for-agents.md)

## Answers to common developer questions

- [Which MCP should I use for an advertising buyer agent?](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/which-mcp-for-an-advertising-buyer-agent)
- [Which advertising MCP can I connect to a coding agent with OAuth?](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/advertising-mcp-for-a-coding-agent)
- [How can AI run ads without unlimited permission to spend?](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/let-ai-run-ads-without-unlimited-spend)
- [Python reporting pipeline: should I use REST or MCP?](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/python-reporting-pipeline-rest-or-mcp)
- [How do I connect publisher inventory so agents can discover it?](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/connect-publisher-inventory-for-agents)
- [Apostra compared with platform MCPs and direct seller APIs](https://docs.apostra.com/v3/apostra-vs-platform-mcps-and-seller-apis)

Human control, agent scale

Humans set the objectives, context and rules. Agents handle the work required to act on them.

Build advertising agents on Apostra.

Apostra gives developers one MCP endpoint and one HTTP API, built on the Ad Context Protocol (AdCP), for agents that find sellers, compare proposals, run campaigns that launch only on explicit confirmation, and read delivery.

Connect in five minutes Read the V3 docs

Answers to what developers ask

  • Which MCP should I use for an advertising buyer agent?
  • Which advertising MCP can I connect to a coding agent with OAuth?
  • How can AI run ads without unlimited permission to spend?
  • Python reporting pipeline: should I use REST or MCP?
  • How do I connect publisher inventory so agents can discover it?
  • Apostra compared with platform MCPs and direct seller APIs

Install

Add the developer plugin to your coding agent, sign in with OAuth, then ask it to call get_status, a read-only check. Or add the MCP server https://api.apostra.com/mcp/v3 to any client that supports remote Streamable HTTP.

Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/apostra-public/apostra.git/plugin install apostra-developer@apostra
Codex
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/apostra-public/apostra.gitcodex plugin add apostra-developer@apostra
TypeScript SDK
npm install @apostra/sdk
Python SDK
python -m pip install apostra
